sources.quote: [FIXTURE] Management shall annually assess and report on the effectiveness of the institution's internal control over financial reporting.
[FIXTURE] The registered public accounting firm shall attest to, and report on, management's assessment of internal control over financial reporting.
[FIXTURE] Each insured depository institution shall file an annual report on compliance with designated safety-and-soundness laws and on internal control.
[FIXTURE] Compliance with designated safety-and-soundness laws (insider lending, dividend restrictions) is retained as a distinct annex.
